about: Picks viewed and validated on 2026-11-02, held out of 2026-W45. Reserved indexes: 0025 The Dunes Club, 0026 Million Goods (0024 is retired: Fontainebleau was dropped under the 2026-11-02 rule that archive rooms must still exist; its 2008 renovation gutted it). Lewie, 2026-11-02: release The Dunes Club in the 2026-W46 batch. Million Goods goes in the first batch without another Joe Thomas post. Skywalker Grill (Dezeen, Tom McGovern, Rockwell Group) was also viewed and is a good later pick; it gets an index when used. Remove an entry from this file when it is batched. Next free index: 0027.

card: THE DUNES CLUB. NARRAGANSETT, RHODE ISLAND.
THE FIRST CLUBHOUSE WASHED AWAY IN 1938.
REBUILT IN 1939 BY THOMAS PYM COPE.
posts.alt_hint: A 1939 beach club room under open timber trusses, with sofas and lamps facing a curved wall of windows onto the sea.
posts.bring: BRING SOMEONE WHO SUMMERED SOMEWHERE WITH A POOL.
posts.survival_check: 2026-11-02: rooms checked against the 2015 National Register nomination (https://preservation.ri.gov/pdfs_zips_downloads/national_pdfs/narragansett/narr_boston-neck-road-137_dunes-club.pdf): club room, loggia and dining room intact (dining room has its original chairs and serving tables); barroom inside the intact core; ocean portico frame removed because the portico has since been glazed.

card: A LANDMARKED BUILDING ON DEKALB AVENUE.
A BRECCIA PERNICE STONE WINE BAR.
posts.alt_hint: A wood-panelled listening bar with a long red-brown stone counter, steel stools and a big speaker set into the shelving.
